best_for: Professionals who need to pitch ideas
not_for: Individuals seeking purely technical design skills (this focuses on delivery + design)
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Those terrified of public speaking should take Soft Skills or Spoken English first.

prerequisites.required: Basic ability to speak in front of others.

overview.positioning: Design and deliver presentations that captivate audiences and drive action.
overview.short_description: Learn to structure compelling stories, design clean slides, and deliver presentations confidently both in-person and virtually using modern tools.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Structure a presentation using storytelling frameworks.
Design visually appealing slides without clutter.
Modulate your voice and use effective body language.
Deliver engaging virtual presentations via Loom and Zoom.

why_now.industry_shift: Virtual presentations demand higher visual quality and energy to keep remote audiences engaged.
why_now.ai_impact: AI can generate slide text, but human delivery and storytelling close the deal.
why_now.business_demand: Leaders are expected to present ideas clearly to secure buy-in.
why_now.career_opportunity: Great presenters stand out for leadership roles.

learning_outcomes: DELIVER: Presentations with confident body language.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Boring product demos losing client interest.

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Eye contact, vocal enthusiasm, reading the room.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Ensure AI-generated visuals match the brand and tone.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Don't read AI-generated scripts verbatim; use them as guides.

best_practices: Use high-quality images instead of bullet points where possible.
Look at the camera lens during virtual presentations, not the screen.

common_mistakes.mistake: Reading text directly off the slides.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Lack of preparation or reliance on slides as a script.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Use slides as visual aids; put the script in speaker notes.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Can hold an audience's attention and convey complex ideas simply.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A polished pitch deck and delivery video.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Review existing deck -> Redesign -> Coach delivery
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Before/after slide examples, video clips of presentations.

assessment.model: Review of the slide deck and video delivery.
assessment.criteria: Visual clarity, storytelling structure, and vocal delivery.

certification.title: Certificate in Presentation Skills
certification.criteria: Completion of final deck and video.

faq.question: Do I need to buy PowerPoint?
faq.answer: No, Google Slides or Canva are perfectly fine for this course.

faq.question: Will we focus more on slides or speaking?
faq.answer: It is a 50/50 split. Great slides need great delivery, and vice versa.

modules.module_purpose: Learn how to organize a presentation for maximum impact.

lessons.what_is_taught: Tailoring your message to what the audience cares about.
lessons.why_it_matters: A presentation fails if it doesn't resonate with the listeners.
lessons.what_learner_does: Profile a target audience for a mock presentation.

lessons.what_is_taught: The Problem-Agitate-Solve (PAS) and Hero's Journey frameworks.
lessons.why_it_matters: Stories keep people engaged better than facts alone.
lessons.what_learner_does: Outline a presentation using the PAS framework.

lessons.what_is_taught: Techniques to start strong (questions, stats, stories) and end with a clear CTA.
lessons.why_it_matters: People remember the beginning and the end most clearly.
lessons.what_learner_does: Draft 3 different hooks for their presentation.

modules.assignment: Submit a complete outline for a 5-minute presentation.

modules.module_purpose: Create slides that enhance, rather than distract from, your message.

lessons.what_is_taught: The rule of thirds, white space, and limiting text.
lessons.what_learner_does: Redesign a text-heavy slide into a visual one.

lessons.what_is_taught: Choosing the right charts and highlighting key data points.
lessons.why_it_matters: Makes numbers easy to understand quickly.
lessons.what_learner_does: Create a clear chart from raw data in Canva/PowerPoint.

lessons.what_is_taught: Selecting readable fonts and high-quality images.
lessons.why_it_matters: Enhances the professional look of the deck.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a consistent slide master template.

modules.assignment: Submit a designed 10-slide presentation deck based on the outline.

modules.module_purpose: Master the physical and vocal skills needed to deliver the presentation.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using pitch, pace, and pauses to emphasize points.
lessons.why_it_matters: A monotone voice puts audiences to sleep.
lessons.what_learner_does: Record an audio snippet practicing strategic pausing.
Practice delivery in front of a mirror or camera.

lessons.what_is_taught: Camera positioning, lighting, and using tools like Loom.
lessons.why_it_matters: Virtual presentations are the new standard.

modules.assignment: Submit the final 5-minute Loom video delivering the presentation deck.
modules.business_application: Impactful remote sales pitches and team updates.
